notes: Same undated scanned booklet as the Rajshahi run (page last updated 2018-09-21; no text layer). The booklet's 'রাজশাহী রিজিয়ন ৫০০০-৬৯৯৯' includes the Rangpur districts: booklet p. 19 (Panchagarh, Thakurgaon), p. 20 (Dinajpur, Nilphamari, Rangpur, Lalmonirhat, Kurigram) and p. 21 (Gaibandha) transcribed by hand from the page images (raw/*.png, PDF pages 11-12 rotated). fetch.py verifies the PDF hash and re-emits the transcription. Branch post offices are not in the booklet. Licence: none stated on the source; treat as government public information, cite the source.
